_comment.webhookUrl: Power Automate Workflow URL from Microsoft Teams (Workflows app -> 'Post to a channel when a webhook request is received').
_comment.enabled: Master switch. Set false to disable all notifications without removing config.
_comment.events: Per-event toggles. askUserQuestion = AskUserQuestion tool, permissionPrompt = tool permission requests, idlePrompt = Claude Code idle prompt, stop = Stop hook (turn finished).
_comment.messagePrefix: Prefix added to every Teams message (e.g. 'Claude Code').
_comment.projectLabel: Optional project name appended to the prefix. null = derive from cwd basename.
_comment.messageDetail: 'full' = include question/prompt body, 'header-only' = include short summary only, 'minimal' = event type only.
_comment.includeOptions: When true, include AskUserQuestion options in the message.
_comment.maxBodyChars: Truncate the message body to this many characters.
_comment.timeoutMs: HTTP timeout for the webhook POST. The hook is fire-and-forget; do not block Claude Code.
_comment.logFile: Path to a local log file for debugging. ~ is expanded to the user's home directory.
_comment.throttleMs: Minimum milliseconds between notifications. 0 = no throttling.
